spec: OASIS OData CSDL XML 4.0: an alias, a plain and a flags enumeration, a type definition, a complex type and one derived from it, collections of primitive and complex values, bound and unbound functions and actions with their imports, a derived entity type, a key the naming heuristic cannot guess, an entity set whose name is not a plural

response.bodyXML:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<edmx:Edmx Version="4.0" xmlns:edmx="http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/ns/edmx">
  <edmx:DataServices>
    <Schema Namespace="Zoo" Alias="Self" xmlns="http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/ns/edm">
      <EnumType Name="Diet">
        <Member Name="Herbivore" Value="0"/>
        <Member Name="Carnivore" Value="1"/>
        <Member Name="Omnivore" Value="2"/>
      </EnumType>
      <EnumType Name="Features" IsFlags="true">
        <Member Name="Stripes" Value="1"/>
        <Member Name="Spots" Value="2"/>
        <Member Name="Mane" Value="4"/>
      </EnumType>
      <TypeDefinition Name="Area" UnderlyingType="Edm.Decimal"/>
      <ComplexType Name="Enclosure">
        <Property Name="Zone" Type="Edm.String"/>
        <Property Name="Opened" Type="Edm.Date"/>
        <Property Name="Area" Type="Self.Area"/>
      </ComplexType>
      <ComplexType Name="Aviary" BaseType="Self.Enclosure">
        <Property Name="Height" Type="Edm.Double"/>
      </ComplexType>
      <EntityType Name="Animal">
        <Key><PropertyRef Name="Id"/></Key>
        <Property Name="Id" Type="Edm.Int32" Nullable="false"/>
        <Property Name="Name" Type="Edm.String"/>
        <Property Name="Diet" Type="Self.Diet"/>
        <Property Name="Features" Type="Self.Features"/>
        <Property Name="Born" Type="Edm.Date"/>
        <Property Name="Home" Type="Self.Enclosure"/>
        <Property Name="Nicknames" Type="Collection(Edm.String)" Nullable="false"/>
        <Property Name="PastHomes" Type="Collection(Self.Enclosure)"/>
        <NavigationProperty Name="Keeper" Type="Self.Keeper" Partner="Animals"/>
      </EntityType>
      <EntityType Name="Lion" BaseType="Self.Animal">
        <Property Name="MaxRoar" Type="Edm.Int32"/>
      </EntityType>
      <EntityType Name="Keeper">
        <Key><PropertyRef Name="Code"/></Key>
        <Property Name="Code" Type="Edm.String" Nullable="false"/>
        <Property Name="Name" Type="Edm.String"/>
        <NavigationProperty Name="Animals" Type="Collection(Self.Animal)" Partner="Keeper"/>
      </EntityType>
      <Function Name="Age" IsBound="true">
        <Parameter Name="animal" Type="Self.Animal" Nullable="false"/>
        <Parameter Name="On" Type="Edm.Date" Nullable="false"/>
        <ReturnType Type="Edm.Int32"/>
      </Function>
      <Function Name="Heaviest" IsBound="true">
        <Parameter Name="animals" Type="Collection(Self.Animal)" Nullable="false"/>
        <ReturnType Type="Self.Animal"/>
      </Function>
      <Function Name="AnimalsIn" IsBound="true">
        <Parameter Name="keeper" Type="Self.Keeper" Nullable="false"/>
        <Parameter Name="Zones" Type="Collection(Edm.String)" Nullable="false"/>
        <ReturnType Type="Collection(Self.Animal)" Nullable="false"/>
      </Function>
      <Function Name="CountByDiet">
        <Parameter Name="Diet" Type="Self.Diet" Nullable="false"/>
        <ReturnType Type="Edm.Int64" Nullable="false"/>
      </Function>
      <Action Name="Move" IsBound="true">
        <Parameter Name="animal" Type="Self.Animal" Nullable="false"/>
        <Parameter Name="To" Type="Self.Enclosure" Nullable="false"/>
        <ReturnType Type="Self.Enclosure"/>
      </Action>
      <Action Name="Feed" IsBound="true">
        <Parameter Name="animal" Type="Self.Animal" Nullable="false"/>
      </Action>
      <Action Name="Admit">
        <Parameter Name="Name" Type="Edm.String" Nullable="false"/>
        <Parameter Name="Diet" Type="Self.Diet"/>
        <Parameter Name="Keeper" Type="Self.Keeper"/>
        <ReturnType Type="Self.Animal"/>
      </Action>
      <EntityContainer Name="Container">
        <EntitySet Name="Animals" EntityType="Self.Animal">
          <NavigationPropertyBinding Path="Keeper" Target="Staff"/>
        </EntitySet>
        <EntitySet Name="Staff" EntityType="Self.Keeper"/>
        <ActionImport Name="AdmitAnimal" Action="Self.Admit" EntitySet="Animals"/>
        <FunctionImport Name="CountByDiet" Function="Self.CountByDiet"/>
      </EntityContainer>
    </Schema>
  </edmx:DataServices>
</edmx:Edmx>
